top_signals.title: OPEC+ Leaves Oil Output Targets Unchanged for December
top_signals.summary: Seven members of the OPEC+ group of oil producers agreed to keep output quotas unchanged in December, after unwinding the last of their voluntary cuts in September.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
